modalLead: Inbox gets snooze, keyboard triage, and bulk clean-up — and Health stays current with optional background rechecks.

items.text: Snooze links for later — park a link for 3 hours, tomorrow, this weekend, or next week. Snoozed items leave the All/Unread lists until they wake, with a dedicated Snoozed filter, grouped wake times, z to snooze, and Wake now when you are ready.
Keyboard navigation matches Health — j/k move, g/G jump first/last, and row keys cover the rest: Enter open, p promote, r mark read, n note, d delete, plus a shortcut legend under the list.
Notes on Inbox links — add or edit a short note on any row (click or n) so you remember why you saved it.
Mark read and bulk clean-up — unread rows get a mark-read button (not only the r shortcut), and the toolbar can mark all read for the current filter or clear read items with one undoable batch.
Fresh links show a preview placeholder — newly added items pulse while the server fetches a preview, then swap it in automatically.
Promote starts a health check — when status checks are on, promoting an Inbox link to a bookmark immediately pings that URL so it does not sit as unchecked on Health until the next full retest.
Inbox toasts show real counts again — bulk and clear actions no longer leak raw {count} placeholders into the notification text.
Health is always available — the header heartbeat entry is permanent. The old Header & buttons toggle that could hide it is gone, so Health stays one click (or Shift+H) away.

Optional background rechecks — turn on periodic server-side re-pings under Config → General → Status monitoring (6h–weekly, default 24h, off by default) so the Health view stays current without a manual Retest all.
Edit opens the dashboard inline editor — Health row Edit no longer dumps you into Config. It leaves the Health view, lands on the bookmark’s page, and opens the inline editor there.
Deep-link filters show the right rows — stale, unused, missing-preview, shortcut-conflict, and healthy filters now match correctly instead of falling back to the full list.
Less chrome in the Health view — the duplicate shortcut legend under the toolbar is gone; one legend stays under the feed.
Active Health underline sits square — the selected heartbeat icon’s bottom border no longer curves up at the corners, matching page tabs and Inbox.
Shift+H is documented where you look for status — the manual now lists the Health shortcut on the header, keyboard table, Health view, Essentials status overview, and :health command row.
